head: 44eee9614d3cd2a44b4a69c7b596a31f0ef24b54
change: Reserve one connection for network SQL migration ownership. PostgreSQL uses a schema-scoped advisory lock. MySQL uses a database-scoped named lock.

SQLite takes BEGIN IMMEDIATE before each migration history read and commit. Connection setup applies a bounded initial busy timeout before WAL setup. Migration wait retries honor cancellation. Ordinary connections regain the 5000ms busy timeout.
Reject schema history with migrations unknown to the current binary.
Retain MySQL DDL intent before execution. Unknown or partial completion refuses automatic replay until operator reconciliation.
